facts.text: The Public Price Match caps tuition and fees at no more than $13,500 for qualifying first-time undergraduates after eligible grants and scholarships.

sources.title: Office of Financial Aid | University of Findlay
sources.quote: For qualifying first-time undergraduate students entering in fall 2027, the University of Findlay's Public Price Match brings tuition and required fees to no more than $13,500 after eligible federal and state grants and Findlay scholarships and grants are applied.
